title: A to-do list for the terminal
summary: A small command-line to-do list that keeps its tasks in a text file. You’ll model tasks with a struct, handle mistakes with Result, read and write a file, and parse the command line.
run: cargo run -- add Buy oat milk

milestones.title: A list of tasks
milestones.build: Fill in `TodoList::new`, `add` and `tasks`. Keep the tasks in the `Vec` and hand out ids from `next_id`, starting at 1. Trim the text before you store it.

milestones.title: Done, remove, pending
milestones.build: Write `complete`, `remove` and `pending`. When no task has the id, return `Err(TodoError::NotFound(id))`. `iter_mut().find(…)` and `position(…)` are handy here.

milestones.title: One task per line
milestones.build: Turn a task into a line of text and back: `[ ] 1 Buy oat milk` or `[x] 2 Call mum`. `from_line` returns `None` for anything else. Try `strip_prefix` and `split_once`.

milestones.title: The whole list as text
milestones.build: `to_text` writes every task’s line followed by a newline. `from_text` reads them back, skips blank lines, reports the first bad line by number, and sets `next_id` after the largest id.

milestones.title: Save to a file
milestones.build: `save` writes `to_text()` with `fs::write`. `load` reads it with `fs::read_to_string`; a file that isn’t there yet is an empty list, and other I/O errors become `TodoError::Io`.

milestones.title: Read the command line
milestones.build: `parse_args` turns `add Buy oat milk`, `done 2`, `rm 2` and `list` into a `Command`. Matching on a slice pattern like `[cmd, rest @ ..]` keeps it short. Anything else is a `Usage` error.

milestones.title: Run a command
milestones.build: `run` applies a `Command` and returns the line to print. Then try it for real: `cargo run -- add Buy oat milk`, `cargo run -- done 1`, `cargo run`.
